integrations.name: Twilio
integrations.purpose: Outbound recovery after DNC, and inbound DID for live callers
integrations.notes: Point the Twilio number voice webhook to /api/voice/inbound. Outbound still requires DNC clear.

integrations.name: ElevenLabs
integrations.purpose: Synthetic customer voice in Path 1 — no lead context, human-like moods
integrations.notes: Customer simulator only. FastAPI still owns consent, fields, and handoff.

integrations.name: Deepgram
integrations.purpose: Voice Agent STT/TTS plus client-side tools owned by FastAPI
integrations.notes: Agent: wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse. Docs MCP: https://api.dx.deepgram.com/kapa/mcp. CLI MCP: dg mcp.

integrations.name: Temporal
integrations.purpose: Durable orchestration of the recovery workflow
integrations.notes: TEMPORAL_ADDRESS is inferred as <namespace>.tmprl.cloud:7233 when not explicitly set.

integrations.name: Azure OpenAI
integrations.notes: Supports AZURE_ENDPOINT Foundry project endpoints and AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT Azure OpenAI endpoints.

integrations.name: TinyFish
integrations.notes: Set TINYFISH_JOURNEY_URL to submit into the browser/API journey sandbox. Operator approve/deny drafts before live submit. MCP: https://agent.tinyfish.ai/mcp
